Definition: {affection (in a good or a bad sense)}
BiblicalUsage: Ohab is affection, love, in a good sense or a bad one. It occurs once, in Proverbs 7:18, where the strange woman says, Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe love taken outside God's bounds is not love at all, and the strange woman's invitation is the warning Proverbs exists to give.
